name: Animate Objects
description:
Roll Lore. Choose up to ten mundane objects within long range, totaling no more than a number of pound equal to ten times the roll result. Each object becomes an animate construct creature while the spell lasts, up to one minute.

While the spell lasts, you may spend a half action to give any number of the objects a simple command. Each will follow its command to the best of its ability using its one action and flying up to 30 ft in any direction to do so if necessary on each of your turns until it is destroyed, given a new command, or the spell ends.
